learning: If line losses persist at ±0.055, the loss comes from curve geometry at y=0.06, so move the row to y=0.045 as the intermediate step. If losses clear and progress holds, the next test is a 0.012 m footprint at this row to see whether the oval floor moves.
notes: Builder's ±0.055 span at y=0.06 with the iteration 6 controller unchanged, so the race isolates span. Expected: no line losses, progress held, slalom oscillation below about 0.15.
rationale: Iteration 6 (outer sensors at y=0.06, span ±0.05) is the best result so far at 51.67. Its gain came from progress on the bends (s-bend 0.157, slalom 0.100), but it cost one line loss each on s-bend and slalom, and slalom steering_oscillation rose to 0.133. The Builder proposes widening only the outer span to ±0.055 at y=0.06, keeping 16 mm footprints and 0.0275 m spacing. I accept that geometry unchanged: 0.06 m was the only lever that moved bend progress, and ±0.055 is the single change that tests whether the losses come from edge coverage. The controller is kept exactly as in iteration 6 (base_speed 1.6, kp 2.5, ki 0.5, kd 0.15, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], last_direction) so the race isolates span. Iteration 2 showed ±0.06 removes losses at y=0.03, and iteration 4 showed ±0.05 did too, so ±0.055 should cover the 25 mm tape without a gap. I expect line losses to fall toward 0 and progress to hold, with no finish yet. The oval floor is likely still near 0.061.
